title: Clock test: TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses fails from 22:00 to midnight
lead: `TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses` builds its expected end times with `vendorUntilText`, so it passes at any time of day, including the two hours before midnight and New Year's Eve.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 22:31 UTC: `TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses` (`internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go:1704-1729`) failed on main and in the S402 and S396 runs: "message lacks "claude is out until 00:31"", while the message said "claude is out until 18 Nov 00:31". The test marks claude out for now+2h and expects a bare HH:MM (`:1723`), but `VendorOut.UntilText` adds the day when the end is not on the day the mark began (`internal/source/source.go:335-358`, S299). So it fails every day from 22:00 to 24:00 local time. The same package already has `vendorUntilText` for this (`internal/daemon/vendors_test.go:55-67`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A test that depends on the wall clock turns the project check red for two hours every day, which sends every running slice into a fix round it cannot fix. Owner rule (2026-11-17): deterministic, regular work is code, and a flaky check is not.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses` in `internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go` fails between 22:00 and 24:00 local time today; after the fix it passes at any time. A new `TestVendorUntilTextCrossesMidnight` in `internal/daemon/vendors_test.go` calls `vendorUntilText` with a since of 23:30 and an until of 01:30 the next day and expects "2 Jan 01:30"-style text, and with an until on the same day expects bare HH:MM.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses`, build each wanted text as `"grok is out until " + vendorUntilText(now.Local(), grokUntil.Local())` and the same for claude, instead of `.Local().Format("15:04")`.
2. Add `TestVendorUntilTextCrossesMidnight` with fixed times (no `time.Now`).
3. Change no product code.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses passes whatever the local time is, including from 22:00 to midnight.
- No product file changes.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/daemon -run 'TestSpecCheckAllRowsOutRefuses|TestVendorUntilTextCrossesMidnight' -count=1 -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` must print nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "Rows-out test: expected end text follows the day rule".
